verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a SaaS accounting platform, so the axis applies. The only recurring-related evidence is subscription recurring billing (moneybird-docs-15), which is a billing feature, not a general job or workflow scheduler. Nothing in the pack documents scheduled automations, cron-style triggers, or recurring workflow execution through the MCP server, CLI, or API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
